brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Tool rack that hangs on wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: 3 keyhole hangers on rear face slot 4 of each of 3 cells (accessory:0#-1,0#4, accessory:0#0,0#4, accessory:0#1,0#4) plus additional slot 3 keyhole on end cell; allows lift-and-drop mounting on wall screws

4 hook plates (hex-acc-hook) installed on front face (slots 0/1) across the 3-cell bar - piece:-1,0,0, piece:0,0,0, piece:1,0,0 - each plate provides two hooks, total 8 hook positions for pliers, tape measures etc.

finish.summary: 3-cell horizontal bar with rear keyhole hangers for wall mounting and front hook plates for hand tools. Verified meshClash clear, joints locked and open faces capped where applicable.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
